Our hands-on shortlist here is ChatGPT and Gemini. Both met the visible text and object conditions in the two briefs below. Start with the account you can already use, rather than buying a plan on the strength of these samples. Other products may fit your task; this small trial does not rank the whole market.

Inspect the first outputs before choosing

On November 25, 2026, each app received the same mug brief and the same fictional poster brief once. All four first retained samples showed the requested object count or lettering. Plans, modes and capture sizes were not matched. These are inspectable examples, not reliability or artistic-quality scores.

For settings, unchanged prompt text, capture limitations and first-output observations, see the Gemini vs ChatGPT image trial. The retained dimensions describe those captures, not either app’s maximum export size.

Build a brief for your own image trial

Write down what must be correct before you generate. This builder assembles your instructions and a manual checklist locally; it does not generate images, upload your description or score an output.

    Download the original mug prompt · Download the original poster prompt

    1. Submit the same brief in fresh conversations. Record the displayed model or mode and your account plan.
    2. Save the first result before retries. Read the text at the size you will actually use.
    3. Record every attempt and correction. For edits, compare both the changed region and the parts meant to stay unchanged.
    4. Choose the app that meets your actual brief within your acceptable effort and cost. Repeat before making a larger purchase.

    Check access, limits and editing before paying

    OpenAI’s current instructions describe image creation and editing in ChatGPT, with usage limits depending on the plan and workspace access. Google’s instructions describe image creation, uploaded-reference editing and full-size download in Gemini, subject to account and regional requirements. Check your current app message; two successful samples cannot establish your allowance.

    Our November 25 image trial covered creation only. It did not test reference-image editing, photorealism, brand consistency, commercial rights, generation latency or cost per usable output. ChatGPT showed Free; Gemini’s subscription entitlement and both underlying image engines were not established. For exact production lettering, proofread the downloaded image and finish typography separately if needed.

    If you need broader assistant features too, use the ChatGPT alternatives task selector. For turning a still into a clip, see the separately tested free image-to-video workflow.
